report.clinical_summary: Patient with HIV for 5 years, on Triumeq for 3+ years, presents with fatigue and occasional headaches for 2-3 months. Viral load is detectable at 340 copies/mL indicating virologic failure. Patient struggles with medication adherence due to work stress and personal issues, though they understand the importance of viral suppression and have made efforts to improve consistency.

The fatigue and headaches have been ongoing for about two to three months now
I understand that keeping my viral load undetectable helps protect my immune system and prevents the virus from causing damage to my body

consequences.reasoning: Patient reports low energy and occasional headaches for 2-3 months, understands the importance of viral suppression for immune protection, but hasn't described significant functional impairment beyond fatigue. Still managing daily life with challenges.
